summary: Title: XRP news: XRP Ledger starts carrying Brazil fund records worth $4 trillion URL Source: https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/09/30/xrp-ledger-starts-carrying-fund-records-from-brazil-operator-overseeing-usd4-trillion Published Time: 2026-09-30T05:22:51.647Z Markdown Content: Updated Sep 30, 2026, 1:45 a.m. EDT Published Sep 30, 2026, 1:22 a.m. EDT 3 min read ![Image 1: Brazil's flag (Rafaela Biazi/Unsplash)](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2Fa010b6e8d5d9fab88360e6939414f5b12c6bf695-1920x1272.jpg%3Frect%3D0%2C96%2C1920%2C1080%26w%3D1920%26h%3D1080%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75) Brazil's flag (Rafaela Biazi/Unsplash/Modified by CoinDesk) Summary * CSD BR is recording ownership of selected BTG Pactual investment funds on the public XRP Ledger, while its database remains the official record for registration, custody and settlement. * The blockchain copy is intended to let approved institutions verify ownership changes in real time, reducing the slow and costly reconciliation process while preserving identity checks and regulatory controls. * After testing the system with live fund records, CSD BR and Ripple plan to explore issuing and trading assets directly on the ledger, potentially including real-estate and agribusiness receivables. A Brazilian financial-market operator responsible for more than 22 trillion reais of registered assets, roughly $4 trillion, has begun putting records for investment funds run by BTG Pactual, Latin America's largest investment bank, onto the XRP Ledger. CSD BR, which operates regulated registration, securities-depository, and settlement systems in Brazil, will use the public blockchain as a second record of who owns shares in selected BTG Pactual investment funds, according to a release shared with CoinDesk. title: Live updates: Bitcoin turns lower as rates rise, consumer confidence plunges
summary: Title: Live updates: Bitcoin turns lower as rates rise, consumer confidence plunges URL Source: https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/09/29/live-updates-bitcoin-rebounds-above-usd84-000-as-treasury-yields-steady Published Time: 2026-09-29T10:14:41.340Z Markdown Content: coverage ended Sep 29, 2026, 5:00 p.m. EDT The Conference Board's Consumer Confidence Index fell to its lowest level in more than a decade in September, with expectations of continued weakening in business and labor market conditions. ![Image 1: Stephen Alpher](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F9c64385838f127845d0783e09a18548c2b886ce2-512x512.png%3Fw%3D64%26h%3D64%26fit%3Dcrop%26crop%3Dfocalpoint%26auto%3Dformat&w=96&q=75) ## 'No need for urgency': Fed's Williams suggests October rate hike not a done deal “With the policy action we took at our September meeting, there is no need for urgency, and we have time to gather more information,” [said Federal Reserve Bank of New York President John Williams](https://www.newyorkfed.org/newsevents/speeches/2026/wil260929) on Tuesday afternoon. His base case, he said, would be for just one more rate hike this year. Williams’ remarks are landing on short-term rate markets, sending the two-year Treasury yield down to 4.88% from as high as 4.96% earlier on Tuesday. October rate hike odds have dipped to just 51% from 70% one day ago.
